evidence.note: The verse names Shem, Ham and Japheth together and calls them בְּנֵי נֹחַ, sons of Noah.
After listing Noah’s sons, the verse repeats Ham’s name in וְחָם הוּא אֲבִי כְנָעַן, identifying him as Canaan’s father.

name: חָם
summary: Ham is Noah's son and the father of Cush, Mizraim, Put and Canaan.
